title: County-cluster bootstrap recheck of the NorCal post-fire mapping-disagreement evidence
intent: Robustness screen for one documented Best Bias Discovery finding: the difference between high-burn and unburned Northern California tracts in the share whose provided Overture-to-USFS building-count ratio falls below the preregistered disagreement cutoff. The published finding was bootstrapped by resampling tracts independently, which understates county-level dependence because tracts in one county share Overture provider mix, terrain and reference vintage. This audit rechecks that difference by resampling whole counties. It is a robustness screen, not model promotion, not an accuracy assessment, and not an estimate of any organiser target.

row_dispositions.intent_from_row: evidence robustness screen, not model promotion
row_dispositions.primary_design_decided_by_row_wording: The row requires 'resampling whole counties and preserving all tract records in each selected county'. Only the joint county resample of the whole analysis population preserves every tract record of a selected county; a within-group county resample would keep only the focal burn class of the selected county and therefore drops records, so it cannot be the primary design. It is retained as a declared secondary sensitivity that cannot change the verdict.

frozen_definitions.disagreement_indicator: ratio < cutoff, i.e. Overture reports materially fewer buildings than the provided USFS WRC count
frozen_definitions.cutoff_source: frozen reports/discovery-postfire.json ratio_definition and config of the original discovery row; copied here and cross-checked at run time, never retuned
frozen_definitions.out_of_bin_policy: a provided burn percentage outside [0, 100] is excluded from the mutually exclusive bins and reported in named exclusion counts; it is never clipped into a bin
frozen_definitions.frozen_report_labels_note: the frozen report renders en dashes; these exact strings are used only to look up its table

provided_overture_feature_cache.regeneration_disclosure: This cache is a derived product of scripts/estimate_gaps.py, not an organiser-provided file, and it was rebuilt after reports/discovery-postfire.json was published, which changed its byte hash. Only GEOID and overture_buildings are consumed here; equivalence with the published analysis is proved content-wise rather than byte-wise: the burn-class table, both focal below-cutoff counts and the per-tract Butte below-cutoff GEOID set must match the frozen report exactly, and the point difference must reproduce it to 1e-12.

primary_design.pool: every county present in the analysis population, each draw uniform over the pool
primary_design.draws_per_replicate: one draw per county in the pool (resample with replacement, equal size)
primary_design.tract_handling: all tract records of a selected county enter the replicate, including tracts of every burn class
primary_design.statistic: share(ratio < cutoff | high_burn) - share(ratio < cutoff | unburned), computed inside each replicate
primary_design.valid_replicate: the replicate contains at least one high-burn tract and at least one unburned tract
primary_design.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 of the valid replicates

robustness_criteria.otherwise: label the finding exploratory in the writeup and do not substitute another design
robustness_criteria.reported_not_gated: these three criteria decide claim retention, they are not audit integrity gates

secondary_sensitivity_designs.description: counties resampled separately inside each focal group; keeps only the focal burn class of a selected county, so it does not satisfy the row's tract-preservation wording and is reported as a sensitivity only
deterministic drop-one-county recomputation over every county in the analysis population; a concentration diagnostic, reported for every county, never used to select a subset

reference_control.description: re-runs the already-published independent within-group tract bootstrap with its frozen seed to prove this audit's machinery reproduces the documented interval; it is the published design, not a substitute for the primary cluster design

writeup_block.note: the qualification must live in Finding 3's Impact and evidence block that carries the published +9.55 percentage-point claim and the county-cluster recheck, not anywhere in the document

negative_controls.mutation: remove county 033, the largest high-burn contributor, from the resampling pool
treat every tract as its own cluster, i.e. resample tracts while claiming counties
compute the indicator with cutoff 0.9 instead of the preregistered 0.8
run 1000 replicates under a different seed
assert a frozen point difference of 0.11 instead of the published value

environment.note: the bootstrap RNG stream is numpy-version dependent, so the run command pins numpy 2.5.4
